review.name: Galvanic Manticore
findings: Freshly frozen original complete face and gold ruff-tip coverage detected the lower-face fold. Three-stage repair preserves original sculpt, textures, 21 bone frames/inverse binds and unrelated animation curves. Four anatomically fitted visible leg chains and sculpt-side remapping replace misplaced old limb influences. Walk/gallop stride 0.55 and vertical excursion 0.45; attack raises both front paws 0.05 with supported rear toes, cast and recoil retain four planted soles. Frozen sole patches contain 345/338/274/312 vertices; original attack sole drift 0.3969 and penetration 0.03827, repaired supporting toes drift below 0.000107 and penetration 0.000057. All 485 geometry poses, 791 frozen face poses, 468 blends, 12 raw source slices and 216 actual technique frames actually inspected and passed. One front-leg and six hind-leg close-ups additionally inspected. Separate source/battle/runtime second review pending.

Final second pass actually inspected all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, all 32 production transition slices at low/medium, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 native actual equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless strips, and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Source and battle each pass 485 full-geometry poses and 468 independent face blends. Original sculpt, UVs, textures, all original bone frames/inverses retained. Complete ruff binding repair plus four fitted limb chains, five gait passes and three coordinated actions. Twelve regression/animation-bank tests and production build pass. Whole-roster/main/live verification still pending.

companionTechniqueAudit.label: independent-legendary-026-anatomical-v1-final-techniques
companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All nine actual equipped techniques rechecked front and side. Complete muzzle, jaw and gold ruff remain stable; shoulder and hip joins stay connected and four anatomical leg surfaces move continuously. Front paws lift through the fitted chains during strikes; rear two support. Cast and recoil retain all four support paws.
